title: The Terminative Case: -ig in Space & Time

sections.title: Expressing spatial endpoints and time limits with -ig
sections.content: The suffix *-ig* (up to, until, as far as) marks both the physical end-point of a journey and the temporal limit. Unlike most case suffixes, *-ig* does not vary with vowel harmony — it is always *-ig*.

items.english: We traveled by train from Budapest as far as Debrecen.

items.spanish: Az indulástól az érkezésig két óra telt el.
items.english: From departure to arrival, two hours elapsed.

items.spanish: Húsz perces késésig a vasúttársaság nem fizet kártérítést.
items.english: Up to a twenty-minute delay, the railway company does not pay compensation.
